zh: 動手之前。龍淵閣中，三把刀，第一次站在一起。
殷九霄，本尊聽說，你是儒門之首。
本尊只是好奇，一個讀聖賢書的人，殺起人來，手會不會抖。
九霄的手抖不抖，今夜，夜兄自會看見。
兩位，留些力氣，給洛無塵吧。
記住：洛無塵最可怕的，不是他的劍，是他的嘴。他說的每一句話，都不要信。
那就不讓他說話。一掌，就夠了。
（一個瘋子，一個沒有臉的人……等洛無塵死了，九霄再一個一個，收拾你們。）
（殷九霄以為，他在利用我們。哈……）
三天之後。蓮心小築，池上只點了一盞燈。
洛無塵斟了兩杯茶。一杯給自己，一杯，給要來殺他的人。
（孤鴻在橋頭。錢不二……應該已經得手了。剩下的，就看這一池蓮花了。）
無塵知道閣主要來，也知道閣主不是一個人來。
走了，閣主這杯茶，就沒有人陪了。
先生是天下最聰明的人。九霄一直很想問：先生覺得，今夜，誰會贏？
洛無塵，本尊聽說，你是天下最難殺的人。
三個人？殷閣主，你太看得起無塵了。
對先生，再多一個，也不嫌多。
孤鴻守在斷橋。洛無塵說過：無論看見什麼，都不要回頭。
先生的拂塵，比九霄想的，還要快。
閣主的扇子，比無塵想的，還要毒。
好一個三千界……可惜，你的背後，沒有眼睛。
那一夜，蓮心小築的一池白蓮，從根到花，一朵一朵，變成了紅色。
不必追。主人死了，一把啞劍，成不了事。
不必。中了夜兄一掌，又落進池裡……蓮心已碎。
死了？洛無塵，就這樣死了？
哈哈哈！好，本郎君不走了。我倒要看看，你在池子裡，能躲多久。
天亮了。紅蓮滿池，卻再也沒有那個帶著半分笑意的人。
洛先生……你還欠我一百兩……你怎麼能就這樣走了……
洛無塵，你這個閒雲野鶴，連死，都死得這麼不聲不響。
阿彌陀佛。無塵，你算盡天下，終究，沒有算到你自己。
我魏無憂，此生還沒有勝過你一次……你怎麼能死！
殷九霄！夜無極！千面鏡王！我發誓，一個都不放過！
魏兄，冷靜。他們三個人聯手，連洛先生都……
那又怎樣？我的刀，不怕死！
燕姑娘：若無塵身死，請將劍譜，交給殷九霄。
交給殷九霄？他就是兇手！
洛無塵死了，腦子也壞了嗎？
從大會到現在，他說的每一句話，都是對的。這一次，我也相信他。
九霄聽說洛先生遇害，特來弔唁。
魏兄何出此言？洛先生之死，九霄與諸位一樣痛心。
殷閣主。這是天劍譜。洛先生說，交給你。
……燕姑娘深明大義。九霄，必定替天下，好好守著它。
（洛無塵啊洛無塵，你到死，都在替九霄鋪路。）
也許吧。可我寧願瘋，也不願意不相信他。
你們等，我不等。我現在就去龍淵閣，砍了殷九霄！
洛先生要我們相信他。他從來不做白白送死的事——也不會讓我們去送死。
老和尚……那一夜，貧道錯怪你了。左手出掌的人，不是你。
阿彌陀佛。白鶴，你沒有錯。錯的，是那張臉。
那張臉，害死了我師兄，害死了洛無塵。貧道這把劍，不會再喝酒了。
他在指池子……他在說，洛先生叫他，不要回頭。
（洛先生交代的事，我已經辦好了……可是，洛先生，你人呢？）
天劍譜到手了。三道封印也在這裡。鏡王，地機卷呢？
地機卷，本王會親手奉上。在帝君點頭之後。
閣主不知道嗎？夜無極的主人，也是本王的主人。幽冥帝君。
你……你從頭到尾，都是幽冥的人？
閣主以為，你在利用本王。帝君以為，閣主是一顆好棋。本王以為……兩位說得都對。
九霄這一生，從來只下棋，不做棋。
池水深處，有沒有人，在等一個回頭的時機？
en: Before the deed. In the Pavilion, three knives stood together for the first time.
Yin Jiuxiao. They tell me you are the first of the Confucians.
Has Brother Ye something to teach me?
I am only curious whether a man who reads the sages’ books has a steady hand when he kills.
Whether my hand shakes, Brother Ye will see tonight.
Gentlemen, keep some strength for Luo Wuchen.
Remember: the most dangerous thing about Luo Wuchen is not his sword but his tongue. Believe nothing he says.
Then we won’t let him talk. One palm will be enough.
(A madman, and a man with no face... once Luo Wuchen is dead, I shall deal with each of you in turn.)
(Yin Jiuxiao believes he is using us. Ha...)
Three days later. At the Lotus Heart Retreat, only one lamp was lit over the pond.
Luo Wuchen poured two cups of tea: one for himself, one for the man coming to kill him.
(Gu Hong is at the bridge. Qian Bu’er... should have done it by now. The rest is up to this pond of lotus.)
In the deeps of the Dragon Abyss, storms lie hidden;
one light wave of the fan, and the nine provinces are settled.
Master Luo. I have come as promised.
The tea is still warm. Please, Pavilion Master.
Master Luo knew I would come?
Wuchen knew you would come — and knew you would not come alone.
...If you knew, why did you not leave?
If I had, there would be no one to drink this cup with the Pavilion Master.
Master Luo is the cleverest man under heaven. I have long wanted to ask: who do you think will win tonight?
Tonight, the Pavilion Master will win.
But the world has more nights than this one.
Luo Wuchen. They tell me you are the hardest man under heaven to kill.
Three of you? Pavilion Master — you think far too much of Wuchen.
For Master Luo, one more would not be too many.
Gu Hong held the broken bridge. Luo Wuchen had told him: whatever you see, do not look back.
Master Luo’s whisk is quicker than I imagined.
And the Pavilion Master’s fan more poisonous than I imagined.
Mirror Light of Ten Thousand Forms!
Lotus Sword Light: Three Thousand Worlds!
A fine Three Thousand Worlds... a pity you have no eyes in the back of your head.
That night, every white lotus in the pond of the Lotus Heart Retreat turned red, from root to flower, one by one.
Let him go. With his master dead, a mute sword can do nothing.
The water is deep. Shall we drag for him?
No need. One of Brother Ye’s palms, and then into the pond... the heart of the lotus is broken.
The Stratagem is in my hand.
Dead? Luo Wuchen — dead, just like that?
Ha ha ha! Good — I’m staying. Let’s see how long you can hide in that pond.
Dawn came. The pond was full of red lotus, but the man with the half smile was gone.
Master Luo... you still owe me a hundred taels... how could you just go like this...
Luo Wuchen, you idle crane — even your death was quiet.
Amitabha. Wuchen, you reckoned out the world, and in the end you never reckoned yourself.
I, Wei Wuyou, have never beaten you once in my life... how dare you die!
Yin Jiuxiao! Ye Wuji! The Mirror King! I swear it — not one of you will escape!
Brother Wei, steady. The three of them together — even Master Luo...
So what? My blade isn’t afraid to die!
Miss Yan: if Wuchen is dead, give the manual to Yin Jiuxiao.
Do not ask why. Trust me.
Give it to Yin Jiuxiao? He is the murderer!
Did Luo Wuchen lose his mind as well as his life?
From the council until now, every single thing he told us came true. This time, too, I believe him.
I heard that Master Luo was murdered, and have come to mourn him.
Yin Jiuxiao — you dare come here!
Why say such a thing, Brother Wei? Master Luo’s death grieves me as much as any of you.
Pavilion Master. Here is the Heavenly Sword Manual. Master Luo said to give it to you.
...Miss Yan understands the greater good. I shall guard it well, for all under heaven.
(Luo Wuchen, Luo Wuchen — even in death, you pave my road for me.)
Yan Feishuang — have you gone mad!
Perhaps. But I would rather be mad than not believe him.
You can wait. I won’t. I’m going to the Pavilion right now to cut Yin Jiuxiao down!
So what? Out of my way!
Master Luo asked us to trust him. He never threw a life away for nothing — and he would not want us to.
...I hate him. He’s dead, and he’s still telling me what to do.
Old monk... I wronged you that night. The one who struck with his left hand was not you.
Amitabha. Baihe, you did no wrong. The face did.
That face killed my elder brother, and killed Luo Wuchen. This sword of mine will drink no more wine.
Gu Hong — what are you trying to tell us?
He is pointing at the pond... he is saying that Master Luo told him not to look back.
That is why it hurts him so.
(I did what Master Luo told me... but Master Luo — where are you?)
The Heavenly Sword Manual is mine. The three seals are here. Mirror King — the Earthly Scroll?
This king will place the Earthly Scroll in your hands himself. Once the Emperor nods.
Did the Pavilion Master not know? Ye Wuji’s master is this king’s master too. The Netherworld Emperor.
You... you were the Netherworld’s man from the very beginning?
The Pavilion Master believed he was using this king. The Emperor believes the Pavilion Master is a fine piece on his board. And this king believes... you are both right.
In all my life I have moved the pieces. I have never been one.
The lotus has withered. Who now can read the Stratagem?
In the deeps of the pond — is someone waiting for the moment to turn back?
